shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat stone surface
profile view of a head with a prominent eye
horizontal band of repeated motifs (rows of beading/hair curls in A; the register of repeating shapes in B)
rendering of body parts (arm/limb) in shallow relief against a plain ground
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on stone in which profile heads with a large emphatic eye and at least one horizontal band of repeating units appear, which is the most concrete correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a single monumental, smoothly modelled human head with meticulous surface detail filling one rectangular panel, while B is a rough, schematic, multi-register array of small animal figures on an irregular pillar still in the ground.
